newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Bank 91-day bill yield up at 7.54 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Bank 91-day bill yield up at 7.54 pct.

text.p: Bangladesh Bank, the central bank, sold Bangladesh Bank 91-day bills worth 1.02 billion taka with the yield rising to 7.54 percent from previous 7.32 percent at an auction on Monday, a bank statement said.
The weighted average price of the accepted bids was 98.15 per 100 taka against 98.21 previously.
The bank also sold 810 million taka worth of 30-day bills at 6.65 percent against previous 7.1 percent. The weighted average price of the bids was at 99.45 per 100 taka against 99.41.
